## What changed

Describe the operator-facing behavior, not only the implementation.

## Decision

What decision should a reviewer be able to make from this change?

## Strongest contradiction

Name the most important contrary evidence or unresolved objection. Write “none found” only after looking.

## Invalidation condition

What observable result would invalidate the decision or require rollback?

## Next validation

Name the smallest useful next check, its owner, and when it should happen.

## Verification

- [ ] Relevant tests pass.
- [ ] Documentation and examples match the behavior.
- [ ] No secrets, private reports, credentials, or local runtime state are included.
- [ ] If this adds a workflow, it has a distinct decision, source strategy, output contract, and fixture.

## Risk and rollback

State any source-policy, storage, migration, or compatibility risk and how to revert it.
